notes.title: 1.5 Update: In Case You Missed It!
notes.notes:
[h2]Just a quick reminder for all you champions out there! [/h2]

Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers is set to have its [b]1.5 update arrive today (June 30, 2022). [/b]

The update does include several fixes for the Skip Button, Typos, Misgendering, and more. However, when testing, we noticed that[b] it caused some Saved Games to become lost.[/b] Most notably, the saves made during the choice menu, while a voice line/sound FX is playing, or when a notable visual effect (such as pop-up animation) is activated. 

To reduce the chance of experiencing any issues [b]please save your game during a scene containing normal text dialogue. [/b]

Alternatively, while Steam will automatically update to 1.5, you can use these instructions to return to an earlier version of the game (version 1.3) if you find that your save was affected. 

To keep playing on your original save using version 1.3: 

[olist]
[*] Right-click on the app in the Steam library 
[*] Click "properties" 
[*] Select "betas" 
[*] Select "Rollback" from the opt-in dropdown 
[*] Steam should automatically update and begin downloading the selected version 
[/olist]
Again, we apologise for any inconvenience this update may cause but we hope you’ll continue your journey on either the 1.3 or 1.5 build of the game!

[h2]The wait is over, champions![/h2]

Your journey to becoming the next esports legend starts HERE in the highly anticipated standalone sequel to [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/910630/Arcade_Spirits/]Arcade Spirits[/url][/i]. Arcade machines have taken the world by storm with the hottest fighter on the market, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524538206859]Fist of Discomfort 2[/url] attracting players from all over the globe to compete in the pro tour. It is up to you to build a team, defeat your rival, and become a true champion... or just enjoy the ride whether you win or lose. Check out our [b]launch trailer below:[/b]

[previewyoutube=u4WBnU7XXBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Head on down to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/4754088250738768693]Good Clean Fun[/url], your one-stop shop for everything pizza, laundry, and arcade related! Conceived by couple Ben and Matt, this establishment is the perfect hang out spot for you and your future team. Meet the new challengers who frequent GCF, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807141665960]Domino[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807142458204]Grace[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807160209374]Jynx[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524534015579]Locksley[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524555670811]Rhapsody[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121561825584172895]Zapper[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/771270506c2e0de8aea4d3625c02ba902f10e0d3.png[/img]

All of these candidates have the potential to become inseparable friends, or even romantic partners. In [i]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/i] you have the option to choose exactly how your friendships develop. Your handy AI companion, Iris, will ask you about your preferences. Are you actively looking for love, open to the idea of a potential relationship, or just here for the thrill of the arcade?

Personality is everything in [i]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/i]. As you progress through the story you'll be faced with several decisions that influence your growing personality, reflected in the traits [b]Quirky[/b], [b]Steady[/b], [b]Kindly[/b], [b]Gutsy[/b], and [b]Flexible[/b]. Your decisions will not only determine how well you get on with other characters, but will also influence [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460592744516]your skills in battle[/url].

[i]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/i] also has a wonderfully diverse [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460573873106]character creator[/url] complete with an extensive list of body types, pronouns, clothing, and accessories. Changed your mind about your arcade avatar? No worries! Make adjustments at the end of every story chapter. 

And remember, for those of you that have completed the original [i]Arcade Spirits[/i], you can import your save and see unique interactions, cameos, easter eggs and more based on your previous actions!

notes.title: Building Your Retro Romance
notes.notes:
Life isn't just about climbing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524538206859]Fist of Discomfort 2[/url] rankings, y'know?

For those of you looking to heat things up a little, [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i] offers plenty of opportunities to develop meaningful relationships with those around you. In fact you can engage in [b]9 different romance paths[/b], involving each of the 6 main characters, and even your rival! 

Throughout the story, you'll be getting to know the regulars of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/4754088250738768693]Good Clean Fun[/url], the arcade/pizzeria/laundromat and the home of your future team. The place is full of interesting people (and pizza toppings) each with their thoughts, feelings, and favorite playstyles (the people, not the pizza).

Fear not as your trusty hand-held helper AI, Iris, is just a click away. Iris automatically tracks the development of your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460592744516]personality[/url] and whether anyone in the group has taken a particular shine to you. 

We appreciate that not everyone will want romance to feature so heavily within the story, and some of you may not want it to feature at all! Well, we've got you covered as when starting your adventure you'll be presented with a choice from Iris: 

[olist]
[*] Bring on the love, and turn on full romance options.
[*] Take it slow and allow romance to blossom naturally.
[*] No romance at all and keep things strictly professional.  
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/fb36c63b2f3664890937a0a769b5e8e6495d2a3d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Analyze Your Appeal[/h3]

Build up enough favor with someone and it will open up different dialogue choices to help further your growing relationship. Play your cards right and a full-blown retro romance is sure to develop! Iris will keep track of your standings with each of the main 6 characters and present you with a summary at the end of each chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/a089be526ec5e848fa21bfcc3ea78d1616122604.jpg[/img]

Each of the romance options offers a unique perspective on various situations that arise during the game. After several key events in the story, Iris will present you with the person(s) your personality gels with the most.

From here you'll be able to see which characters a possible romance could blossom with. This is entirely dependent on your interactions with those characters and the dialogue options you've chosen up until this point. 

[h3]Pay Attention to Your Team[/h3]

Building an esports team from the ground up while trying to balance a social life can be tricky. Not everyone will agree on decisions (such as sponsors etc...), and it's up to you to decide whether you should go with what's best for the group, or the individual.

Keep a close eye on the bottom left of your screen to pick up on which characters agree with your decisions. This will be indicated by a teammate's personal avatar popping up with a handy chime as Iris takes note of their reaction to your decisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/58069de124aac7883a0aacf3a47463c8c1d8f093.jpg[/img]

[h3]Date Night![/h3]

If you've successfully nurtured a strong relationship with your arcade crush you'll eventually get the opportunity to take them out on a date. Here, you'll be faced with even more options on how you want this relationship to play out, do you go in guns blazing or take it slow? You can also change your mind at any stage if you realise it just wasn't meant to be... :(

Hopefully, this has given you a good foundation for understanding and beginning your next retro romance or friendship.

notes.title: Mastering the Fist of Discomfort 2 mini-game
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome Challengers![/h2]

In [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i] you'll be taking on the best of the best as your team strives to reach the top of the legendary [b]Fist of Discomfort 2[/b] world rankings. Here are some insider tips and tricks to prepare you on your journey to becoming an FoD2 [b]CHAMPION![/b]

[h3]What is Fist of Discomfort?[/h3]
Originally conceived by designer [b]Jason Takeshi[/b] as a fun side project to combat the monotony of his day job, [b]Fist of Discomfort[/b] rapidly gained a huge following of devoted fans. Now the game's sequel is lighting up the world of competitive esports, with challengers from all corners of the globe battling it out to be crowned champion. Entire gaming careers are being made and shattered in the name of [b]Fist of Discomfort[/b]!

[h3]Tournament of Champions[/h3]
Tournament season is here and the competition is fierce! Only the top 8 officially sponsored esports teams can be put through to compete. You'll soon find yourself pitted against some serious fighters, including members of [b]L7[/b], [b]The Four Heavenly Kings[/b], and arch rivals - [b]Team Play-2-Win[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/2ef058b1fc072f42ab6f5d815ef7801ba6666723.png[/img]

[h3]How Do You Play?[/h3]
Typically played in teams of two, the aim is to defeat your opponents by achieving the highest score over four rounds, represented in-game by the seasons: Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter. At the start of each round you’ll choose from one of three actions for your character to perform: 

[b][i]Attack! 
Defend!
Special![/i][/b]

All moves have a specific counter, for example; Attacking will power through an opponent's Special move while a Special move can get around an enemy's Defence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/f2c21c457a2c0dac2672d2b148b440644d618a1a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Outsmart the Competition[/h3]
FoD2 is as much a mind game as it is a straight-up brawler. To guarantee victory one must first know how their opponent will react. FoD2 is, in a nutshell, all about anticipation. So constantly being on the attack is no use against a player that likes to play defensively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/e3f3c2a0e677b38ffda1abe25b5a7a8c33250af7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/d191acf73e0633885fc47eb7f826e5c05eb879f8.jpg[/img]

Strategic use of an [b]ultimate[/b] ability can also change the tide of battle. This once-per-game move is totally unavoidable, awarding a massive point bonus unless countered by another [b]ultimate[/b]. 

[h3]Maximizing your score through your personality[/h3]
Another way to score bonus points is to choose a move that matches your personality!

As we covered in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460592744516]previous post[/url] you will develop specific personality traits based on the decisions you make throughout [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i]. Whether that be quirky, steady, kindly, or gutsy, you name it, these traits will match up with certain actions and give you a particular edge in battle. Beware, your opponents also gain a personality advantage so basing your strategy on your own emotions alone may not always be the best idea!

[i][h3][b]Think you have what it takes to become an esports legend?[/b][/h3][/i]
We'll be back with another update soon!

notes.title: Develop Your Arcade Spirits Personality
notes.notes:
Hello challengers!

Today we're going to be looking at how your character's personality will gradually develop during a playthrough, and how this affects your interactions, relationships, and gamer skills!

[h3][b]Developing your personality[/b][/h3]

Dialogue options in games can be a scary thing. Do you choose what best befits you or do you try and seek a particular outcome? While there are no inherently "good" or "bad" choices in [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i], there are a wide variety of outcomes and consequences which will be linked to the development of your in-game personality. 

This means that when faced with an opportunity to respond or interact with other characters and situations, you'll have multiple dialogue options to choose from, each tied to a specific personality trait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/f4a118a05fe9cae065be7e63b0644d1b80a9cd04.png[/img]

[h3][b]Personality Traits[/b][/h3]

Your personality is based on a natural blend of 5 different traits: 

[list]
[*] [b]Quirky[/b] - Using jokes, sarcasm or being a bit snarky to try and make light of a situation. Quirky is brilliant in the right crowds but not everyone appreciates a badly timed joke.
[*] [b]Steady[/b] - Sincerity, honesty, and logic are what you're all about. You stop and think before speaking but might not always take someone's personal feelings into account.
[*] [b]Kindly[/b] - You're compassionate, empathetic, and gentle in nature. You're careful with what you say as to not hurt anyone's feelings but this may come across as wishy-washy.
[*] [b]Gutsy[/b] - When in doubt, go with your gut! This bold and brash trait emphasises risk-taking but could be seen as confrontational or aggressive.
[*] [b]Flexible[/b] - Lastly there's being flexible. A perfectly neutral response that's adaptive to multiple situations.
[/list]
Over time, your trusty AI companion, [b]Iris[/b], will gather data on which personality traits you lean towards the most and tally up the results after each chapter. Bear in mind certain characters will respond more positively to specific personalities, something to keep in mind if you're looking to build a stronger relationship with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/a089be526ec5e848fa21bfcc3ea78d1616122604.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Improving your game![/b][/h3]

These choices not only affect your relationships with other characters but also determine your stats when playing Fist of Discomfort 2, [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers'[/b][/i] interactive, narrative driven, mini-game! Having more points in the Gutsy corner, for example, will give you bonus points for [b]Attacking[/b] rather than [b]Defending[/b] or using a [b]Special[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/262fb93f5232946425fd4a9fa4101293245e7b6b.jpg[/img]

Playing to your strengths can be a great way of accumulating extra points but be careful and pay attention to your enemies' personalities and attack patterns as well.

We hope you enjoyed this update, next time around we'll be taking a look at [i]Good Clean Fun[/i], the pizzeria/laundromat/arcade where you'll learning the FoD2 ropes with your teammates!

notes.title: The New You: Character Creator & Customization
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome back challengers![/h2]

Today we'd like to shine a spotlight on the new and improved character creator for [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i]. Building on the success of the original [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/910630/Arcade_Spirits/][b][i]Arcade Spirits[/i][/b][/url] and taking on board community feedback we've introduced a number of new features to help you to tailor your character.     

[h3][b]Customization Options[/b][/h3]

When you begin a new game you'll be asked to create your character using a range of adjustable criteria. Players will get to choose from a variety of options including:
[list]
[*] [b]Name & Handle -[/b] Pick a name and a creative gamer handle. You'll also have the option to decide how other characters refer to you throughout the game.
[*] [b]Online Avatar -[/b] What gamer profile is complete without an awesome avatar? Here you'll be able to pick your online avatar to compliment the iconic designs belonging to your team mates. 
[*] [b]Pronouns -[/b] Choose from a wide variety of pronouns: He/Him, She/Her,
They/Them, Ze/Zir, Ze/Hir, Ze/Mer, Ze/Zher, It/Its, Xe/Xem, Ey/Eirself, Ey/Emself, Ne/Nem, Ve/Ver, Fae/Faer, Ae/Aer
[*] [b]Skin Tone -[/b] The gaming scene is as diverse as ever, so let your character reflect this by selecting a natural skin tone from a palette of 30 choices. 
[*] [b]Hair Style -[/b] From casual styles to stylish contemporary cuts, create a new look and choose from 100+ dyes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/42dcdc7fd8d37f02df1bcb7c5864e3ac23ce56b5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Eye Color -[/b] Explore some truly eye-catching looks or reflect your own eye color.
[*] [b]Nose Selection -[/b] Pick from a range of distinctive facial features.
[*] [b]Body Type & Shirt -[/b] Select your body type from a range of shapes and sizes, and pick out some stylish new threads to complement your look.
[*] [b]Pants & Skirts -[/b] Smart-casual or light and breezy? 
[*] [b]Glasses -[/b] A selection of interesting frames to choose from, from the studious to the outrageous!
[*] [b]Headwear -[/b] Strengthen your hair game with headwear that comes in multiple sizes for the perfect fit.
[/list] 
With the new character creator we're aiming to give players much more freedom, and we hope you'll enjoy discovering the numerous combinations that are possible. All customization options will be available regardless of the pronouns or body type chosen. 

Change is good, so we've also added the option to adjust all of the aforementioned options mid-playthrough as your character develops (You'll have the option to make changes at the end of each story chapter).   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/addef6a49982ef8548e0bdd6ca3cfed0d6ce00c1.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Designing Your Rival[/b][/h3]

In addition to the player character, you'll be tasked with designing an arch rival! The same options will be available when editing with the exception of their shirt colour, which is locked to a nefarious black. A word of warning though as your rival's appearance can [b]NOT[/b] be altered again during the game. Something to bear in mind if you happen to pick a particularly 'creative' name for them...you better believe they'll be stuck with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/bd05d2eb6f7ef61bfcc7033af62070117293395d.png[/img]

We can't wait to see what designs you all come up with! Remember[i][b] Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i] launches on [b]May 27 2022! [/b]

We'll be back with another update again soon!
